title: Cloud-Media-Bridge generic media worker request (planned contract)
description: Task-independent typed inputs for any Hugging Face media model family. The worker/request executor is NOT YET IMPLEMENTED. This schema does not authorize provisioning.

task.description: Canonical or new Hub pipeline tag; must not be restricted to a short hardcoded media list

runtime_recipe_digest.description: A pinned and verified recipe, never inferred from Hub metadata alone

inputs.description: Multi-input model support: text, image, video, sound, music, 3D, spatial, documents, embeddings or future types

parameters.description: Checked against the selected runtime/task schema before execution, not executed as commands

kind.description: Examples: text, image, video, audio, speech, music, 3d, spatial, document, embedding, timestamps, any; extensible

asset_ref.description: Authenticated, validated asset location; not an unsigned public bearer URL

media_type.description: MIME type of asset; checked against actual bytes at runtime
